title: cascade.compat.v1
description: Compatibility matrix between nSelf and the Cascade engines (Cascade and Cascade.app) for the claw/v1 contract. Late-binding: entries are added as each engine ships, so an engine capability may be pending. Frozen: a breaking change ships as cascade.compat.v2.

claw_contract.description: The nSelf-side contract the matrix was checked against, for example claw/v1.

nself_version.description: nSelf CLI version the matrix was generated with (semantic version, no leading v).

generated_at.description: UTC time the matrix was generated (RFC 3339).

entries.description: One entry per engine and engine version, ordered by engine then version.

Capability.description: One late-binding engine capability and its state.

name.description: Capability name, lower-case dotted, for example tools.invoke.

status.description: supported: works against the engine. partial: works with the limits in notes. unsupported: the engine does not provide it. pending: the engine has not shipped it yet.

notes.description: Plain-language limits or the engine release that is expected to provide it.

MatrixEntry.description: Compatibility of one engine version with the claw contract.

engine.description: cascade is the engine; cascade.app is the desktop application.

engine_version.description: Engine version the entry was checked against (semantic version, no leading v).

status.description: Overall result. verified: every required capability supported. partial: some capabilities are partial or pending. unsupported: the engine cannot drive the Bundle. unknown: not yet checked.

verified_at.description: UTC time the entry was last checked (RFC 3339); absent while status is unknown.

notes.description: Free-text remarks for people reading the matrix.
